objection: Foil packets are wasteful, and I take magnesium at home, so I get no benefit from the portability. A dollar a serving is high next to bottled bisglycinate.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle or refill version of the same capsules at a lower price per serving, or an NSF or USP certification on top of the batch reports.
